source.book: 剑桥KET青少版官方真题2（扫描版）

parts.1:
Test Four. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
PART 1
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
Question 1
One. What do they want to buy in the department store?
Man: This looks like a good shop. We could get that maths book you need for school here.
Girl: I'm sure it'll be cheaper on the internet, Dad.
Man: Yes, you're right. So have we got everything then?
Girl: We've already bought some school shoes so I just need a coat. Let's get that here.
Man: OK.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 2
Two. Where did the boy go this morning?
Girl: Hi, where have you been? You look tired.
Boy: I usually play football in the park on Saturday mornings, but my friends were doing other things this week so I decided to go to the pool instead.
Girl: Are you going home now?
Boy: Yes, for lunch. Then I'm meeting a group of friends at the cinema later on. Why don't you come too?
Girl: Thanks!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 3
Three. Who is the girl going to meet?
Boy: Are you going out?
Girl: Yes, I'm meeting my friend Amelia – she's just started at our school.
Boy: Oh, is she the girl with glasses and long blonde hair?
Girl: You got the length right but it's actually quite dark. I've never seen her wearing glasses.
Boy: Oh yes, I know who she is now. Well, have a good time.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 4
Four. How will the boy help his mum?
Boy: Is dinner nearly ready, Mum?
Mum: No, and I need to go to the supermarket because we haven't got any milk.
Boy: Oh no. Well why don't I cut some vegetables while you go there?
Mum: That's really kind of you, but I've already done it. How about putting all the knives and forks and things on the table?
Boy: OK, no problem.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 5
Five. Where did the girl spend the day with her family?
Boy: Did you have a good day yesterday?
Girl: Yes, I went out with my family. It was great to spend some time away from the city!
Boy: Sounds nice.
Girl: It was. We often go to this little village by the sea where there's a nice beach, but we all wanted a change, so we went up into the mountains instead.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part One.
parts.2:
PART 2
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher telling her class about some changes to the school library.
Woman: Good morning everyone. I'd like to tell you about some changes to the school library. You can now borrow books not for two weeks, but for three.
You will need a new library card, which is available at the front desk, which you'll see when you enter the library. It's opposite the information desk.
The library will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day and until 7:45 on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
We have a new manager working in the library, Mrs Carter. I'll spell her name for you. C-A-R-T-E-R. You might need to email her for advice.
There are quiet areas where you can do your homework. Please remember you can't use phones anywhere in the school, but you can bring your tablet to do project work in the library.
There will be a different exhibition in the library every month, on subjects such as history. And we'll start with a really interesting one about fashion. Has anybody got any questions?
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Two.
parts.3:
PART 3
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear Johnny talking to his friend Lily about a school trip to a museum that they went on.
Johnny: Hi Lily, did you enjoy the school trip?
Lily: Hi Johnny, I thought the science museum might not be interesting, but it was OK. Except I woke up late and didn't have time for breakfast – I couldn't stop thinking about food!
Johnny: I'm glad our teacher decided to book a bus for the trip. My sister's class had to walk all the way from the train station. What did you enjoy most?
Lily: The information about the moon and stars was interesting, but my favourite was finding out why people get ill and how doctors help them. I knew that stuff about electricity already.
Johnny: The museum shop had some great pictures, but I didn't have enough money.
Lily: Did you get that book you were looking at?
Johnny: I decided to get a game because I enjoy those more.
Lily: I can't wait for the next trip. I hope we go to the countryside to find out how our food's grown and how the animals are looked after. It's more interesting than visiting an old castle or something.
Johnny: I'd prefer to see some famous paintings.
Lily: Art's not for me.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Three.
parts.4:
PART 4
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Question 16
Sixteen. You will hear a teacher talking to a student called Gemma. Why can't Gemma play hockey today?
Man: Ah Gemma, you're back from the dentist's. I hope you're playing in this afternoon's hockey match.
Girl: I'm really sorry I can't. After seeing the dentist, when I was getting out of my mum's car my hockey stick fell out of my sports bag and hit my foot.
Man: Oh dear.
Girl: It's really painful and I can't run.
Man: I'm sorry to hear that.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 17
Seventeen. You will hear a boy talking to his aunt about school. What did he do at school last week?
Woman: How's school, Sam?
Boy: It's great! I won a prize last week, for a 500-word story I did in English. It was about coming first in a running race. It wasn't true. I don't even like sport!
Woman: Wow! Have you ever considered getting a part in the school play?
Boy: No. But I might try.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 18
Eighteen. You will hear two friends talking about a café. Why do they like going there?
Boy: I really like going to Toni's Café.
Girl: So do I. It's a good place to do homework after school. You can always get a table. And the cookies are the best.
Boy: True. And the cakes. I'm surprised that not many other people from school hang out there.
Girl: I guess it's a bit expensive.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 19
Nineteen. You will hear a girl telling a friend about a holiday. What was the weather like on her holiday?
Boy: How was your skiing trip?
Girl: Fantastic! It was so bright all week that I had to wear sunglasses whenever I went outside. It's hard being back here – grey clouds, day after day.
Boy: But it's warmer here.
Girl: True. I don't need so many clothes! There wasn't much snow when we got there. Then the last two nights, nearly a metre fell.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
Question 20
Twenty. You will hear two friends talking about going shopping. What are the deciding?
Girl 1: You know we're meeting outside the cinema to go shopping tomorrow?
Girl 2: Yes. I'm looking forward to going to that new clothes shop opposite the department store. I'm still getting a lift with Mum – she's fetching my brother from the train station at midday.
Girl 1: Perfect. My bus arrives just before then. So see you at quarter past.
Girl 2: Sure.
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Four.
parts.5:
PART 5
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear two friends talking about a school sports day. What sport will each person do?
Girl: It's great that our classmates are doing so many different sports today!
Boy: Yeah, Anne's done a lot of swimming this term. Is she doing that today?
Girl: Actually, she's playing volleyball today.
Boy: And what's Alex doing?
Girl: Last year he was in a rugby team, but today they needed someone for the football team, so he'll do that because he's a good runner. Do you know what John's doing?
Boy: He wanted to do tennis, but there were too many people, so he's playing hockey instead. What about Sally?
Girl: We will see her in the pool! That's at two o'clock, just after the football. Is Ben playing baseball? He was really good last year.
Boy: He was, but he started running at the beginning of the year. He's doing the 100 metres. What about you, Mary?
Girl: I've just got a new racket, so I'm excited to use it for the first time. I'm glad about that because I didn't want to do hockey again!
Boy: It's going to be great!
Now listen again.
[repeat]
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
[ping]
You have one more minute.
[ping]
That is the end of the test.

explanations.p1q1: 爸爸说 "We could get that maths book you need for school here."，但女孩回答 "I'm sure it'll be cheaper on the internet, Dad."，数学书准备在网上买；学校鞋已买好，女孩还需要一件外套："We've already bought some school shoes so I just need a coat."，因此选择 B。数学书和鞋都是排除掉的干扰画面。
explanations.p1q2: 男孩说 "I usually play football in the park on Saturday mornings, but my friends were doing other things this week so I decided to go to the pool instead."，他通常去公园踢球，但朋友这周有别的安排，所以改去游泳池，因此选择 B。电影院是之后的计划（"I'm meeting a group of friends at the cinema later on."），不是今天早上去的地方。
explanations.p1q3: 男孩猜 Amelia 是 "the girl with glasses and long blonde hair?"，女孩纠正 "You got the length right but it's actually quite dark. I've never seen her wearing glasses."，即 Amelia 是长发、深色头发且不戴眼镜的女孩，因此选择 A。金发和眼镜这两个特征都被否定了。
explanations.p1q4: 妈妈要去超市买东西："I need to go to the supermarket because we haven't got any milk."；男孩提议切蔬菜，妈妈说 "I've already done it. How about putting all the knives and forks and things on the table?"，蔬菜已切好，她请男孩把刀叉等摆到桌上，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q5: 女孩说 "We often go to this little village by the sea where there's a nice beach, but we all wanted a change, so we went up into the mountains instead."，他们常去海边小村庄，但这次想换个地方，最后去了山里，因此选择 B。海边小村庄是常去的旧地方，不是这次的目的地。
explanations.p2q1: 老师说 "You will need a new library card, which is available at the front desk"，借书证在前台领取，因此填 front。她补充 "It's opposite the information desk"，information desk 在 front desk 对面，不要误填 information。
explanations.p2q2: 老师说 "The library will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day and until 7:45 on Tuesdays and Thursdays."，周二和周四延长到 7:45 闭馆，因此填 7:45。每天平时的 6 p.m. 闭馆时间和早上 8 a.m. 开门都是干扰信息。
explanations.p2q3: 老师说 "We have a new manager working in the library, Mrs Carter. I'll spell her name for you. C-A-R-T-E-R."，图书馆新管理员姓 Carter，老师还逐字母拼写确认，因此填 Carter。
explanations.p2q4: 老师说 "you can't use phones anywhere in the school, but you can bring your tablet to do project work in the library."，手机全校禁用，平板电脑可以带来做项目，因此填 tablet。phone 是被明确禁止的干扰项。
explanations.p2q5: 老师说 "There will be a different exhibition in the library every month, on subjects such as history. And we'll start with a really interesting one about fashion."，第一个展览的主题是时尚，因此填 fashion。history 只是老师举例说明以后每月展览的话题，不是首个展览。
explanations.p3q1: Lily 说 "I thought the science museum might not be interesting, but it was OK. Except I woke up late and didn't have time for breakfast – I couldn't stop thinking about food!"，她原以为科学博物馆可能无聊，但觉得还可以；因为起晚没吃早餐，她一直想着食物，所以她的感受是饿，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q2: Johnny 说 "I'm glad our teacher decided to book a bus for the trip."，老师为这次参观订了公交车，因此选择 A。他姐姐的班级才是 "walk all the way from the train station"，从火车站一路步行。
explanations.p3q3: Lily 说 "The information about the moon and stars was interesting, but my favourite was finding out why people get ill and how doctors help them. I knew that stuff about electricity already."，月亮和星星的信息只是有趣，电学她已经知道，她最喜欢的是了解人为什么生病、医生如何帮助人们，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q4: Johnny 说 "The museum shop had some great pictures, but I didn't have enough money."，他觉得图片不错但钱不够；Lily 问 "Did you get that book you were looking at?"，他回答 "I decided to get a game because I enjoy those more."，最后选择了游戏，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q5: Lily 说 "I hope we go to the countryside to find out how our food's grown and how the animals are looked after. It's more interesting than visiting an old castle or something."，她想了解食物如何种植、动物如何被照顾，对应农场，因此选择 C；她还明确说 "Art's not for me."，对艺术不感兴趣，城堡也被认为不如乡村有趣。
explanations.p4q1: Gemma 说 "After seeing the dentist, when I was getting out of my mum's car my hockey stick fell out of my sports bag and hit my foot."，她看完牙医后下车时，曲棍球杆从运动包里掉出来砸到脚，还说 "It's really painful and I can't run."，疼得无法跑步，属于受伤，因此选择 A。牙医预约只是当天的时间背景，体育包也带在身上（杆是从包里掉出来的），B、C 都不对。
explanations.p4q2: 男孩说 "I won a prize last week, for a 500-word story I did in English."，他赢得了英文写作比赛的奖，作品是一篇 500 词的故事，因此选择 B。跑步比赛第一名只是故事里的情节："It was about coming first in a running race. It wasn't true."。
explanations.p4q3: 女孩说 "It's a good place to do homework after school. You can always get a table. And the cookies are the best."，男孩补一句 "True. And the cakes."，两人特别喜欢那里的饼干和蛋糕，因此选择 C。做作业和有桌位只是顺带提到的优点，价格反而 "it's a bit expensive"，并不低。
explanations.p4q4: 女孩说 "It was so bright all week that I had to wear sunglasses whenever I went outside."，整个星期都很晴朗、需要戴太阳镜；雪是 "Then the last two nights, nearly a metre fell."，最后两晚才下很多雪，所以总体是寒冷且晴朗，因此选择 C。每天下雪和大部分时间多云都与原文不符。
explanations.p4q5: 两人已约好 "we're meeting outside the cinema to go shopping tomorrow?"，也谈到想去的店（百货商场对面的新服装店），最后确定的是见面时间："So see you at quarter past."，因此选择 A。去哪些店和回家的交通方式（坐妈妈的车 / 坐公交）都已经定好，不是正在决定的内容。
explanations.p5q1: Alex 去年在橄榄球队："Last year he was in a rugby team"，但今天 "they needed someone for the football team, so he'll do that"，因为他跑得快，所以 Alex 今天踢足球，因此选 B。rugby 是去年的队，running 只是他被选中的原因。
explanations.p5q2: John 本来想打网球，但 "He wanted to do tennis, but there were too many people, so he's playing hockey instead."，人太多改打曲棍球，因此选 C。tennis 是被放弃的选项，不是他今天参加的项目。
explanations.p5q3: 男孩问起 Sally，女孩回答 "We will see her in the pool!"，Sally 会在泳池里，即参加游泳，因此选 F swimming。
explanations.p5q4: 女孩猜 "Is Ben playing baseball?"，男孩回答 "He was, but he started running at the beginning of the year. He's doing the 100 metres."，Ben 从年初开始练跑步，今天参加 100 米赛跑，因此选 E running。baseball 只是女孩的错误猜测。
explanations.p5q5: Mary 说 "I've just got a new racket, so I'm excited to use it for the first time."，她新买了球拍并第一次使用，对应网球，因此选 G tennis。她还庆幸 "I didn't want to do hockey again!"，曲棍球是她不想再玩的项目。

uncertain: p4q20 引导行书上印为 "What are the deciding?"（疑为 they 的排版误印），已按逐字规则照抄；站内题目文本作 "What are they deciding?"，不影响作答。
